title: Project digest cold-window read: skip it on the dirty-worktree branch, and take selection and progress from one state
outcome: Project digest cold-window read: skip it on the dirty-worktree branch, and take selection and progress from one state
acceptance: The digest skips the cold-window read when it will use the Git summary, and the chosen session's progress comes from the same state observation as its selection, so a concurrent hydration cannot give fallback text for that build; both covered by behaviour tests without timing thresholds.
